description:
The top subplot titled “Easy Training Set” illustrates training rewards over optimization steps for two methods, shown as two solid lines with translucent uncertainty bands. The x-axis is labeled “Steps,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 500 with labeled ticks at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500. The y-axis is labeled “Training Rewards,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly 0.0 to 0.4 with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.2, and 0.4. A blue solid line (legend: “Llama-On-Policy-Easy,” no markers) starts near 0.0 at step 0, rises to about 0.25 by around 100 steps, reaches roughly 0.33–0.35 around 200 steps, and then fluctuates in the mid-0.3 range through the end, ending near about 0.35–0.36 at step 500. A red solid line (legend: “Llama-LUFFY-Easy,” no markers) also starts near 0.0, increases to roughly 0.22–0.24 by about 100 steps, is around 0.30 near 200 steps, and continues trending upward with oscillations, reaching around 0.38–0.40 late in training and ending near about 0.40–0.41 at step 500; both lines are accompanied by faint, same-colored shaded bands around them.

The bottom subplot titled “Hard Training Set” shows training rewards over steps for two corresponding methods on the hard set, again with solid lines and translucent uncertainty bands. The x-axis is labeled “Steps,” linear, spanning 0 to 500 with labeled ticks at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500. The y-axis is labeled “Training Rewards,” linear, spanning roughly 0.0 to 0.2 with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.1, and 0.2. A blue solid line (legend: “Llama-On-Policy-Hard,” no markers) begins near about 0.03 at step 0, decreases toward 0.0 over the early portion of training (approaching ~0.0 by roughly 80–120 steps), and then stays essentially at 0.0 through step 500. A red solid line (legend: “Llama-LUFFY-Hard,” no markers) starts near 0.0, rises to roughly 0.08 by about 50 steps and around 0.11 by about 100 steps, reaches approximately 0.14–0.15 around 200–300 steps, shows small oscillations in the mid-to-high 0.1 range later on, and ends near about 0.21 at step 500; the red and blue lines each have a faint, same-colored shaded band surrounding them.
